Cassie: opened a PR to standardize runtime telemetry examples and add simple audit-export scrubbing guidance: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1422
Alex: looks sensible. Are we changing field names in examples or just adding redaction patterns?
Cassie: both. Examples will show a "pseudonymous_id" and an explicit "tenant_id". Also including tiny pre-export scrub snippets that HMAC tenant_id using a KMS-managed salt and an allowlist so routing keys remain untouched.
Jordan: paste the Go snippet so I can mirror it in the runtime hook.
Cassie: short one in the PR: ```// redactBeforeExport hashes tenant_id and removes free-text
func redactBeforeExport(evt map[string]interface{}, salt string) map[string]interface{} {
  if v, ok := evt["tenant_id"].(string); ok {
    mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(salt))
    mac.Write([]byte(v))
    evt["tenant_id"] = fmt.Sprintf("hmac:%x", mac.Sum(nil))
  }
  delete(evt, "raw_prompt")
  delete(evt, "user_message")
  return evt
}
```
Maria: Legal note: avoid the acronym "PII" in public docs. Use "sensitive identifiers" and show examples of what gets redacted.
Lee (Compliance): Agreed. Also call out that routing metadata (region, shard, route_key) must not be redacted. Reference the central Audit Retention page instead of hardcoding TTLs. Add a compliance sign-off checkbox on the PR.
Cassie: added a TS example that copies an allowlist of keys and runs a simple regex to scrub email-like tokens. Left a TODO for a unit test in the PR.
Jordan: i'll open a tiny test PR for the TS snippet and link it to the main PR.
Alex: i'll do a quick compile + lint pass on the Go snippet tomorrow AM. Keep imports minimal.
docs-bot: PR referenced: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1422 — reviewers requested: @Lee (Compliance), @Alex
Cassie: plan to merge after Alex verifies compile/lint and Lee completes language pass. Will run snippet linter before merging. Thanks all.
